name: upkeep
description: macOS system cleanup and updater. v1.5 collapses the macOS update flow into a single shell orchestrator (scripts/update.sh) — the skill becomes a thin two-turn wrapper, cutting user-perceived pre-gate latency to <5s on warm cache. Adds brew-update TTL caching (1h default, opt-out via UPKEEP_NO_CACHE=1). Replaces the v1.3 failure-diagnoser LLM agent with a deterministic pattern table (scripts/diagnose.sh) covering Ruby version, native build deps, EACCES, pipx venv, dyld load, arch mismatch, version-solver failures, and brew post-install errors. Enrichment (changelog-reader + project-impact agents) is now opt-in behind --advisor and runs after the gate so it never blocks the user. v1.4 fast discovery preserved: scripts/discover.sh + scripts/synthesize.sh. All v1.2/v1.3 security invariants preserved: hardcoded dispatcher, discovery JSON sanitization, exact-match remote URL validation, trust-on-first-use, plan/apply turn separation. Linux/WSL2 still on v1.0 sequential flow (fast-path port scheduled for v1.6). Five entry points: deep, quick, audit, update, upkeep.
